title: Kamailio World 2026 – Call for Presentations
html:
We would like to announce that Call for Presentations at Kamailio World 2026 is now open. You can submit your proposal or see more details at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2026/call-for-speakers/

The 14th edition of the event continues as an in-person event in Berlin, Germany, during May 7-8, 2026. Expect a large range of participants, developers and Kamailio community members as well as representatives from other popular open source VoIP projects.

Looking forward to meeting many of you there!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
